title: Open injective Leray edge monomorphism
statement: Let Λ be a commutative ring, h:Y→X, e:Y→T, j:V→T, eV:W→V, a:W→Y and h′:W→X scheme morphisms with a≫e=eV≫j and a≫h=h′. Assume the square (eV,a,j,e) is Cartesian and j is a quasi-compact quasi-separated open immersion. Let q≥1 be an integer and assume BaseChangeProperty Λ e n for every n<q [sbc-def-base-change-property]. For every injective étale Λ-module sheaf J on V, the canonical target transition t(j_*J) [def-sbc-canonical-base-change-stalk-transitions], followed by baseChangeTargetFunctor(Λ,eV,h′,q) applied to the counit j*j_*J→J, is a monomorphism.

source.place: closed-open argument, lower-degree comparison / Leray edge

proof.text: Take the cone of the derived unit followed by the pullback comparison and coefficient counit. Lower-degree comparison makes its homology vanish below q, and the long exact sequence plus the lower bound on the source makes the q-th derived pushforward map monic. Naturality identifies this map with the displayed transition.

theorem baseChangeTargetTransition_counit_mono
    {X Y T V W : Scheme.{u}} (h : Y ⟶ X) (e : Y ⟶ T) (j : V ⟶ T)
    (eV : W ⟶ V) (a : W ⟶ Y) (h' : W ⟶ X)
    [IsOpenImmersion j] [QuasiCompact j] [QuasiSeparated j]
    (wa : a ≫ e = eV ≫ j) (wh : a ≫ h = h')
    (sq : IsPullback eV a j e) (q : ℤ) (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (hprev : ∀ n < q, BaseChangeProperty Λ e n)
    (J : Sheaf V.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) [Injective J] :
    Mono (baseChangeTargetTransition Λ e h q j a eV h' wa wh
      (((j)_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).obj J) ≫
      (baseChangeTargetFunctor Λ eV h' q).map
        ((upperStarLowerStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) j).counit.app J))
